Chapter 6373: Save Us, Ancestor!

Chapter 6373: Save Us, Ancestor!

Disciples who had yet to partake in wars were shocked to see the most powerful emperors in action.

Each move caused untold destruction. For example, Solar Monarch’s heavenly hammer was unstoppable and could crush a kingdom, leaving an ocean of lava behind.

This was akin to summoning a hell gate, letting the infernal flames swallow everything. Fortunately, Desolate Frontier’s grand momentum was strong enough to keep the land relatively intact.

“Eternal Blood Lake!” Unable to withstand the barrages, Goldclad and Lostmetal spewed out true blood. Their allies did the same thing.

When their blood touched Centurial Peak, dao runes emerged and a red light illuminated all of Desolate Frontier.

A frightening visual phenomenon emerged and scared everyone - a lake of blood with no end in sight. Calling it an ocean was more accurate.

The blood was immensely thick, a result of flesh and bones being refined as well. The surface surged with ghastly images, giving the impression of countless specters wailing. The dead seemed to be waking up and raising their hands, wanting to pull others down with them.

“Why is this monstrosity here?” Everyone became alarmed about the hellish lake.

“Is it just an image?” One disciple turned pale, nearly wetting his pants.

Although they couldn’t verify it, they felt the existence of this lake in Centurial Peak.

“Countless corpses and souls are buried there.” An elder said.

“From the sacrificed members, right?” One disciple felt nauseous and had a hard time standing still.

They were told the legacy process required sacrifice but didn’t imagine the scale. Upon seeing the blood lake, they realized it was far greater - potentially in the hundreds of thousands, not only cultivators but also mortal descendants.

“Boom!” The sanguine light aided the grand momentum to fuse with the two emperors.

The force of numerous living beings erupted into a blastwave. It contained incredible power and swept through Centurial’s territories. It caught members of the Chen off guard and disintegrated them.

Dragon-pill and Solar were shocked. They roared and used their anima power to try and stop the red blastwave. Unfortunately, it repelled them continuously.

“This is bad!” Others could see the blastwave spreading toward the rest of Desolate Frontier.

It simply melted everything along the way, not leaving mountains behind, let alone bones.

“Crimson Azure Cauldron!” Crimson Virtue appeared with a cauldron.

It grew into an azure, attempting to stop the blastwave. Dragon-pill’s energy dragon and Solar’s hammer helped him.

“The audacity!” A badge descended from above.

“Heavenbreak Badge!” Everyone shouted but was forced to the ground by its power.

This was a treasure left behind by Desolate Ancestor. Now, it was in Absolute Ancestor’s possession.

It was enough to stop and push the blastwave back to the red lake. Finally, the lake crumbled, revealing Goldclad, Lostmetal, and everyone else who was a part of the attack.

“Save us, Ancestor!” They bellowed because Absolute Ancestor showed no mercy.

Her badge destroyed the image of the lake and pressed down on them. In this split second, weaker cultivators were reduced to blood, albeit literally this time.
